name: Help Yourself
description: Find resources for your personal wellbeing journey
notes: Individual acting on own sleep. Top-level choice in the "Get personalized" modal.

name: Help Others
description: Resources to support others in their wellbeing
notes: Umbrella for everyone acting on someone else (interpersonal through policy). In the modal it opens a second page listing the audience taxonomy tree.

name: General Public
notes: Catch-all parent; its children mix ages, genders, identity, life stage (College), role (Parents) and employer (Employees, Municipal employees). Facet shows 69 because it rolls up children; own count is 42.

name: Parents
notes: Role acting on a child. Largest Help Yourself-tagged audience term (19 of 27), which conflicts with an interpersonal reading.

name: College
notes: College students as a population. Duplicates Universities > Students (all 14 College resources are tagged Help Others).

name: Employees
notes: Worker as an individual. Overlaps Workplace (setting) and Municipal employees.

name: by identity or Community
notes: Grouping node only (count 0); lowercase "by" unlike By Age/By Gender.

name: LGBTQIA+
notes: Population by identity (intrapersonal) or community level depending on content. Unused (count 0).

name: African American
notes: Population by identity (intrapersonal) unless resources are culturally tailored community outreach (community). Unused (count 0).

name: By Gender
notes: Grouping node only (count 0).

name: Women
notes: Population by gender.

name: Men
notes: Population by gender.

name: By Age
notes: Grouping node only (count 0); exists to group age terms in the facet.

name: Young Adults
notes: Population by age; no age range in name unlike Kids/Seniors. Overlaps College and Students.

name: Youth
notes: Population by age; no age range given; overlaps Kids (6-12) and Young Adults.

name: Kids (6-12)
notes: Population by age. Resources (e.g. kids sleep apps) are often used through a parent, so arguably interpersonal.

name: Seniors (60+)
notes: Population by age; unused (count 0).

name: Municipal employees
notes: Population defined by employer; unused (count 0). If content is about city HR policy it would be organizational.

name: Healthcare Professionals
notes: Clinician acting on patients (clinician-patient level); could be organizational for health-system content. Slug "healthcare" does not match name.

name: Universities
notes: Institution as audience. Parent of Professors and Students, so it mixes institution and population.

name: Students
notes: University students as population; duplicates General Public > College.

name: Professors
notes: Faculty acting on students; could be organizational for campus-policy content.

name: K-12 Eductors
notes: School staff acting within an institution; teacher-student content would be interpersonal. Name and slug misspelled ("Eductors").

name: Workplace
notes: Setting, not a person. Overlaps Employees.

name: Millitary & Law Enforcement
notes: Institutional setting (duty schedules, shift policy). Mixes two sectors; name and slug misspelled ("Millitary"). Overlaps Veterans.

name: Pro2Pro
notes: Undefined label (likely professional-to-professional). No description; 3 resources.

name: Science Journalism
notes: Media shaping public knowledge and norms. Named for a field, not a person (vs "Science journalists").

name: Veterans
notes: Population; overlaps Military & Law Enforcement. 1 resource.

name: PR
notes: Communications professionals shaping public messaging. Meaning of "PR" not explained on site; 1 resource.

name: Help myself
description: Find resources for your personal wellbeing journey
notes: Mirrors upper-lvl-audience "Help Yourself" but named "Help myself" (different wording, casing and slug). Default term set by the CredibleMind importer (term id 366).
